pages.text: Evolved from the $(l:goety:focuses/void/troop_focus)Troop Focus$(/l), allows you to configure your army more conveniently.$(br)Right-click with the focus in hand to bind a $(l:goetymech_machines/squad_barracks)Squad Barracks$(/l) or $(l:goetymech_machines/soul_monument)Soul Monument$(/l); sneak + right-click to unbind.$(br)The casting logic differs between binding a Squad Barracks and a Soul Monument — hold Shift while holding a bound focus for details.$(br)$(4)"Fight for me, my servants!"$()
